what: The WebMCP tool surface the BestPrice.gr storefront registers, read from the source of truth in the bestprice.gr repository.
extraction: webmcp/src/contract-parity.js readStorefrontSurface: title, description and output schema from extra/mcpDiscovery/webmcp-tools.json; input schema and annotations from the object literals the page modules register, with module and imported constants resolved
pagesFrom: tools/scripts/mcp_discovery_json.php webmcp.pages: the manifest the site serves, which the storefront checks against the tools each page registers

search_bestprice.title: Search BestPrice products
search_bestprice.description: Search BestPrice by name, optionally by price, stock, deals, sort. Returns product_id, title, price, stores. Use for names; not for advice (use get_shopping_decision) or a known id (use get_product_details). Moves this tab unless navigate: false.

query.description: Product, brand, model, or shopping need to search for, in Greek or English.

limit.description: Maximum results to return, from 1 to 8. Defaults to 6.

navigate.description: Move this tab to the results page after reading it. Defaults to true; false only reads.

min_price_eur.description: Only products from this price in euros (item price before shipping).

max_price_eur.description: Only products up to this price in euros (item price before shipping).

sort.description: Sorting of the results. relevance is the page’s default; newest, biggest_price_drop and most_stores only where the results page offers them (the answer says).

in_stock_only.description: Only products a store has in stock now («Άμεσα διαθέσιμα»). Defaults to false.

deals_only.description: Only products priced below their earlier price («Προσφορές»). Defaults to false.

results_kind.description: featured: a category’s highlighted rows. product: one product’s own page.

reason.description: not_offered: see offered_sorts. no_product_list: an overview or one product’s page. page_unreadable: results unnarrowed.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

store_offer.description: Links straight to its store; page tools never open it.

navigated.description: The result, in one field: whether the tab moves to results_url.

reason.description: When given, one of: invalid_argument, timeout, upstream_unavailable, cancelled, unexpected_error.

pageDescriptions.product: Search BestPrice by name, optionally by price, stock, deals, sort. Returns product_id, title, price, stores. Use for names; not for advice (use get_shopping_decision) or this product (use get_page_product). Moves this tab unless navigate: false.

get_visible_products.title: Products on this page
get_visible_products.description: Read the products shown on this BestPrice listing or home page. Returns product_id, title, lowest price, stores, 8 per call. Use to see what is shown; not for others (use search_bestprice). Read-only; load_more loads more results into the listing.

limit.description: Maximum products to return, up to 8 per call; next_offset continues.

offset.description: Use next_offset from the previous result on the same page. Defaults to 0, or with load_more to the first newly loaded product.

load_more.description: Listing pages: first load the next result page into this listing, as the shopper’s scroll does, then read from its first new product. Use it when more_pages is true. The only argument that changes the page.

more_pages.description: Pass load_more: true for the next page.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

store_offer.description: Links straight to its store; page tools never open it.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset to continue; null at the end.

open_visible_product.title: Open a visible product
open_visible_product.description: Open a product shown on this BestPrice listing or home page by product_id. Returns it and whether the page confirmed the move (outcome). Use when the shopper picks one; not for unseen products (use get_product_details). Moves this tab.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

outcome.description: The result, in one field. confirmed: read from the destination before the tab moved; no follow-up read. observed_complete: shown here. dispatched: the tab moves, destination unread (unconfirmed_reason). unconfirmed: read the page again.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

product.description: The product page, read before the tab moved there.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

unconfirmed_reason.description: Why the destination could not be read first, e.g. timeout.

reason.description: When given, one of: invalid_argument, missing_product, store_offer, cancelled.

get_product_details.title: Product details
get_product_details.description: Read one BestPrice product by product_id; read-only unless navigate: true moves this tab to it. Returns facts, price, offers, specs, history. Use when you hold an id; not for finding (use search_bestprice) or choosing (use get_shopping_decision).

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

include.description: Sections to read: offers, specifications, price_history. Defaults to all three.

navigate.description: After reading, move this tab to the product’s BestPrice page (bestprice_url). Defaults to false: only reads. Opens no store site.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

offers.description: Up to 4, known delivered price first; each: store, prices, availability, rating.

price_history.description: Price history: period, current, lowest, highest, directions; null when unreadable.

unavailable.description: Why a requested section is null.

navigated.description: The result, in one field: whether the tab moves to bestprice_url.

reason.description: When given, one of: invalid_argument, not_found, timeout, upstream_unavailable, cancelled, unexpected_error.

bestprice_url.description: Where the tab moves, after this answer.

pageDescriptions.product: Read another BestPrice product by product_id, e.g. one from search_bestprice or get_shopping_decision; read-only unless navigate: true. Returns facts, price, offers, specs, history. Use for other products; not for this one (use get_page_product).

get_listing_filters.title: Available filters
get_listing_filters.description: List this BestPrice listing’s filters (brand, price, features) and their values. Returns up to 8 filters, 5 values each, selected ones marked. Use before apply_listing_filter; not for sorting (use get_listing_sort_options). Read-only.

group.description: A filter key or name a previous call returned; returns that filter with all of its values, including those behind «Εμφάνιση όλων».

offset.description: Use next_offset from the previous result with the same group, or none. Defaults to 0.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset to continue; null at the end.

apply_listing_filter.title: Apply a filter
apply_listing_filter.description: Narrow this BestPrice listing by one filter value, e.g. Κατασκευαστής: Samsung. Returns the value applied and whether the page confirmed it. Use with labels from get_listing_filters; not for removing (use clear_listing_filters). Reloads the listing.

filter.description: A filter name or key as get_listing_filters returned it.

value.description: A value exactly as get_listing_filters returned it; a unique part of it also works; an ambiguous one is refused.

outcome.description: The result, in one field. confirmed: read from the destination before the tab moved; no follow-up read. observed_complete: shown here. dispatched: the tab moves, destination unread (unconfirmed_reason). unconfirmed: read the page again.

destination_url.description: Where the tab moves, after this answer.

destination.description: What the destination page shows, read before the tab moved there: its filters, sort, total and first products.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

unconfirmed_reason.description: Why the destination could not be read first, e.g. timeout.

reason.description: When given, one of: invalid_argument, not_found, ambiguous_value, not_available, cancelled.

clear_listing_filters.title: Clear filters
clear_listing_filters.description: Remove one filter value, one filter, or every filter from this BestPrice listing. Returns what was removed and whether the page confirmed it. Use when filters left too few products; not for adding one (use apply_listing_filter). Reloads the listing.

filter.description: Remove only this filter (name or key as get_listing_filters returned it). Without it, every filter goes.

value.description: With filter: remove only this selected value of it.

outcome.description: The result, in one field. confirmed: read from the destination before the tab moved; no follow-up read. observed_complete: shown here. dispatched: the tab moves, destination unread (unconfirmed_reason). unconfirmed: read the page again.

destination_url.description: Where the tab moves, after this answer.

destination.description: What the destination page shows, read before the tab moved there: its filters, sort, total and first products.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

unconfirmed_reason.description: Why the destination could not be read first, e.g. timeout.

reason.description: When given, one of: invalid_argument, not_found, ambiguous_value, not_available, cancelled.

get_listing_sort_options.title: Available sorting options
get_listing_sort_options.description: List the sorting options this BestPrice listing offers, with a key (e.g. price_asc) where one applies. Returns each option’s name, key and whether it is active. Use before apply_listing_sort; not for filters (use get_listing_filters). Read-only.

key.description: Pass it, or name, as apply_listing_sort’s sort.

apply_listing_sort.title: Sort this product listing
apply_listing_sort.description: Sort this BestPrice listing by one of its sorting options, by key (e.g. price_asc) or label. Returns the option and whether the page confirmed it. Use with get_listing_sort_options; not for narrowing (use apply_listing_filter). Reloads the listing.

sort.description: A key get_listing_sort_options returned (relevance, price_asc, price_desc, biggest_price_drop, most_stores, newest) or an option’s label; one unambiguous partial label also works.

outcome.description: The result, in one field. confirmed: read from the destination before the tab moved; no follow-up read. observed_complete: shown here. dispatched: the tab moves, destination unread (unconfirmed_reason). unconfirmed: read the page again.

destination_url.description: Where the tab moves, after this answer.

destination.description: What the destination page shows, read before the tab moved there: its filters, sort, total and first products.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

unconfirmed_reason.description: Why the destination could not be read first, e.g. timeout.

reason.description: When given, one of: not_found, not_available, invalid_argument, cancelled.

get_page_product.title: Product details on this page
get_page_product.description: Read the product on this BestPrice product page. Returns product_id, title, category, lowest price before shipping, offer count, rating and URL. Use first on a product page; not for its store offers (use compare_page_offers). Read-only.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

compare_page_offers.title: Compare offers on this page
compare_page_offers.description: Compare every store offer on this BestPrice product page, 12 per call with offset; product_id guards the page. Returns delivered price first, stock, rating, offer_ref. Use to find where to buy; not for others (use get_product_details). Read-only.

limit.description: Offers to return, from 1 to 12. Defaults to 4. Lowest known delivered price first, then unknown shipping by item price.

offset.description: Use next_offset from the previous result to read the next offers. Defaults to 0.

include_all_stores.description: First load the stores this page keeps behind «Όλες οι τιμές», as when the shopper presses it. Defaults to false.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.
Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset to continue; null at the end.

excluded_unknown_shipping.description: Offers left out for unknown shipping; cheapest is shaped like offers[].

reason.description: When given, one of: invalid_argument, missing_product, cancelled.

get_product_specifications.title: Product specifications
get_product_specifications.description: Read the specifications of the product on this BestPrice page: all, one section or one fact. Returns section, name and value rows, 16 per call. Use to check a feature; not for another product’s specs (use get_product_details). Read-only.

section.description: Use all or a section name shown on this product, such as Οθόνη, Ισχύς, or Διαστάσεις.

limit.description: Maximum number of specification facts to return, from 1 to 16.

fact.description: A specification fact name, such as one a previous call returned, or a common English name (refresh rate, screen size, weight, energy class…) matched to the product’s own Greek one. Returns that fact in full, from whichever section lists it; pass its section too when the name appears in more than one section.

offset.description: Use next_offset from the previous result, keeping the same product and section. Defaults to 0. Do not combine with fact.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset to continue; null at the end.

summarize_price_history.title: Price history summary
summarize_price_history.description: Summarize this product’s BestPrice price history; show_chart: true also opens the chart. Returns current, lowest, highest price, period, direction. Use to judge when to buy; not for other products (use get_product_details). Read-only by default.

show_chart.description: Also open or scroll to the price-history chart on this page for the shopper. Defaults to false.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

chart.description: With show_chart: what the chart did.

show_offer.title: Show an offer for this product
show_offer.description: Highlights one store offer so the shopper can open that store; no tool opens a store site. Returns the offer and if it is in view. Use offer_ref, else merchant_name; not for comparing (use compare_page_offers). Changes only what the shopper sees.

offer_ref.description: Pass offer_ref (from compare_page_offers) or, failing that, merchant_name. Exact, and the only selector that can separate two stores with the same displayed name; a reference names one quote and is refused once the page state, the merchant, the variant or any price or shipping amount changes: read the offers again.

merchant_name.description: Only without offer_ref: the merchant name exactly as compare_page_offers returned it; it must match exactly one shown offer.

offer_visible.description: The result, in one field: true once the offer is in the shopper’s view.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

reason.description: When given, one of: offer_not_found, ambiguous_value, invalid_argument, missing_product, cancelled.

show_price_history.title: Show this product price history
show_price_history.description: Open or scroll to this BestPrice product page’s price-history chart: the UI-only shortcut. Returns which happened. Use when the shopper wants only the chart; not for the numbers (use summarize_price_history). Changes only what the shopper sees.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

reason.description: When given, one of: insufficient_history, missing_product, invalid_argument.

get_shopping_decision.title: Get a shopping decision
get_shopping_decision.description: Ask the BestPrice Shopping Brain (mcp.bestprice.gr) what to buy for stated needs. Returns a pick, alternatives, reasons, tradeoffs or a question. Use for advice; not for names (use search_bestprice) or a known id (use get_product_details). Read-only.

message.description: The shopper’s question as they asked it (Greek or English), with budget and required features, e.g. «κινητό έως 400€ με NFC». Sent to the Shopping Brain on mcp.bestprice.gr.

postal_code.description: Optional five-digit Greek delivery postcode the shopper gave (10000–85999); adds shipping and delivered totals.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.
Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

catalog_candidates.description: no_match only: unranked search results, not a recommendation.

product_id.description: Numeric BestPrice product id, as any tool returns it.

pageDescriptions.product: Ask the BestPrice Shopping Brain (mcp.bestprice.gr) what to buy for stated needs. Returns a pick, alternatives, reasons, tradeoffs or a question. Use for advice; not for names (use search_bestprice) or this product (use get_page_product). Read-only.
